summary: The agent performs reasonable feature engineering, including TF-IDF vectorization and missing value handling. However, the solution concatenates the training and test sets prior to imputation and TF-IDF fitting, resulting in data leakage. Furthermore, the agent fails to implement an internal train/validation split to evaluate model performance before generating final predictions.
